children: Atossa made an updated corporate presentation available highlighting (Z)-Endoxifen clinical progress, regulatory designations and $26.1M cash.
Updated investor presentation released (Exhibit 99.1) summarizing (Z)-Endoxifen across oncology, MAS and DMD programs.
$26.1M cash and equivalents and no debt at June 30, 2026; funded into 2027 with up to $12M potential from warrants.
Regulatory: Rare Pediatric Disease designations for MAS and DMD, Orphan Drug Designation for DMD; IND clearances anticipated in 2H26.
Clinical: ~800 patients dosed to date; EVANGELINE Phase 2 enrollment completed and I-SPY2 combinations ongoing; Ph2 starts for DMD/MAS planned for 1H27.
Product profile: (Z)-Endoxifen is an oral active metabolite with dual ER antagonism and PKCβ1/AKT modulation, claimed 30–100x potency vs tamoxifen.
